_doc: Ramanas Park's items (b2tools/patches/ramanas_park.py --text writes this file from data/ramanas_park.json): the slates (BDSP's names; Stratospheric shortened to the Bag's 96 px) and the Mysterious Shards S/L, with BDSP's descriptions (Serebii's itemdex), Pal Park for Ramanas Park. Every version's slates are here: a Diamond version only changes which rooms exist.

res/items/unused_120/data.json.name: Discovery Slate
res/items/unused_120/data.json.description:
A slate overflowing with enigmatic energy.
You can feel a strong connection between
it and the Discovery Room at Pal Park.
